necessary_observation_for_direct_depende: A workflow/check would need to install or otherwise resolve the mlx optional group, and for runtime-path coverage also satisfy the relevant platform/hardware/engine-selection conditions.

scope_limit: This record does not claim that every automation or release workflow in the repository omits the mlx extra. The workflow directory contains additional automation that was outside the owned test-coverage question.
